headline: Johannesburg Stock Exchange Targets Secondary Listing for Dangote Refinery
summary: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange is seeking a secondary listing for Dangote Petroleum Refinery to grant the Nigerian energy company access to South African capital markets.
why: Cross-border secondary listings increase capital-raising capabilities and broaden investor bases for major regional energy corporations.

impacts.name: Dangote Petroleum Refinery
impacts.why: A secondary listing provides access to a wider pool of institutional investors.
